title: Glassmorphism Design System (ferrox-front-ui)
description: ferrox-front-ui provides a complete, enterprise-grade Glassmorphism Design System for WebAssembly applications. It includes Design Tokens, a 12-column responsive layout grid, a Virtualized DataGrid (1,000,000+ rows), and a comprehensive library of pre-styled UI components.
